  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:

Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.

We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.

We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.

About the Project:

This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:

  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets

Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas

Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments

What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness

Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)

Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction

Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner , not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

Proactively analyze latest developments in large language models to deeply understand model capabilities, limitations, and best practices. title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.

Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.

What You'll Get

Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs

Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition

Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support

100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties

Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region

What We're Looking For

Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:

Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.

Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.

Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.

Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.

Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.

Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.

The Deal

We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.

If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.

If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:

title: Product Owner SR
description:

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)

We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.

Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments

  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models

Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure

What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director) - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!

Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain "Brilliance or Nothing" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the "Stream Team" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.

Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.
Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.

title: Crypto Venture Analyst
description:
Crypto Venture Analyst

Company: Meta Martian

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Department: Investment & Research

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.

The Investment Mandate and Regional Focus

Meta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd; you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.

Due Diligence and Deal Flow Mechanics

This role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous "under the hood" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.

Thesis Generation and Tokenomics Forensics

We do not invest in "vibes." We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing . You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.

What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)

To respect your time, let us define what this role is not :

  • Not a "Spray and Pray" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.
  • Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.
  • Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action; we care about multi-year technology horizons.
The Analyst Archetype
  • You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a "degen" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Java para atuação em cliente Atos de forma remota.

Habilidades Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado da linguagem Java: Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, generics), JVM, garbage collection e otimização de performance.
  • Frameworks e bibliotecas: Spring Framework (Boot, MVC, Security), Hibernate/JPA, e conhecimento em alternativas como Micronaut ou Quarkus.
  • Padrões de design e arquitetura: SOLID, design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer), arquitetura de microsserviços, RESTful APIs e event-driven architecture.
  • Bancos de dados: SQL avançado (queries complexas, otimização) e ORM (Object-Relational Mapping).

Ferramentas e DevOps

  • Ferramentas de build e versionamento: Maven/Gradle, Git/GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Testes e qualidade: JUnit, Mockito, TestNG, TDD/BDD, cobertura de testes e ferramentas de análise estática (SonarQube).
  • Containerização e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, e conceitos de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

Habilidades Complementares

  • Segurança e performance: OWASP, criptografia, tuning de aplicações e monitoramento (ELK Stack, Prometheus).
  • Integração e APIs: Mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ), GraphQL e integração com sistemas externos.
  • Soft skills: Liderança técnica, mentoria de equipes, comunicação eficaz, resolução de problemas complexos e trabalho em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos
  • Plano odontológico
  • Programa de remuneração variável

  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)
  • Terapia online
  • Massoterapia
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro
  • Day off no seu aniversário

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Desde 2005, fazemos parceria com algumas das maiores entidades dos setores de saúde, ciências da vida, serviços financeiros e governo em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade empolgante para um(a) Líder de Engenharia de Software altamente qualificado(a) se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica.

Tipo de Contrato : Tempo Integral

Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços

Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.

Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.
  • Definir padrões de engenharia, melhores práticas e diretrizes arquiteturais para a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, QA e DevOps para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções técnicas e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Orientar engenheiros, promovendo aprendizado contínuo, qualidade na execução e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar revisões de código para garantir aderência aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade.
  • Resolver desafios técnicos avançados e influenciar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura e seleção de tecnologias.

Lead Software Engineer | Habilidades & Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)

You already know how to build software that works.

What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.

This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.

Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability

Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.

If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.

Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.

That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.

The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.

Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.

The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.

The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.

Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe

If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

title: 销售工程师
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: ) is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.

Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.

Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.

Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese , and English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of the Americas every two weeks.

Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto) Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.

O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.

Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia
O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.

You Are

An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

Responsibilities
  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction
Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.

Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:

VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.

VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.

About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).

While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).

Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.

We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.

The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!

Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community

What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)

Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments

VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided

Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.

This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.

About the Role:

As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.

Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.

Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.

How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga

Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.

Missão da função

Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.

Reporte e interfaces

  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno

Principais responsabilidades

Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)

  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.

Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial

  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.

Negociação e fechamento

  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.

Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado

  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.

Metas e indicadores (referência)

  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.

Diferenciais (alto peso)

  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).

Exclusividade e conflito de interesses

  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.

Modelo de remuneração

  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.

Suporte da Mobiis

  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax

If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.

This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.

If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.

Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.

Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our .

Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.

What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail

Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
